relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Toll-like receptor 4/myeloid differentiation primary response 88 (TLR4/MyD88)-dependent signaling triggers TNF-α/IL-1β release

relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: Hyperglycemia-induced AQP4 polarity disruption (via matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9)-mediated β-dystroglycan cleavage [39])

relationships.subject: TBK1
relationships.evidence_quote: TANK-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) emerged as a critical mediator of NLRP3 inflammasome activation via non-canonical NF-κB signaling.

relationships.subject: P2X7
relationships.evidence_quote: In STZ-induced diabetic models, spinal P2X7 receptor (P2X7R) expression increased, predominantly localized to Iba1+ microglia in the dorsal horn.

relationships.subject: Sirt3
relationships.evidence_quote: Sirt3 overexpression in BV-2 microglia attenuated high glucose-induced Iba-1 expression and suppressed IL-1β/TNF-α production through NF-κB/MAPK inhibition [36].

relationships.subject: IL-35
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings establish IL-35 as a potent activator of the JAK2/STAT6 cascade in pain regulation [38].
